items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Babe and I were doing some college really dates

ctx.x: This was after he left ?, of course.

Yeah, it could have been around that time. ... I was going uptown one night on the subway so I saw Barney; I don't think Barney knew me that well. He knew I played trumpet. So he says, What you doing? Well, things were happening very good for us at that time. Babe and I were doing some college really dates and so I didn't want to be pinned down. And, he said Why don't you come on out and go in the band with me? I said, That's a helluva offer from a guy like you. I mean I've got some things I've got to do. So we…
